title: The spritesheets from AI are becoming better and better
author: GreatAdvantage57
selftext:
I am still working on this project. the character images are generating fine. Now, working on the animation improving and general UX.

The only interesting point here is that some details on the frames are moving too. If we look closely, we can see that some pixels are blue and red on diff frames. 

By the way, pixel snapping and spritesheet normalization are very important in such staff. I recommend people to not ignore these 2 processes to get better assets

What do you think?

comments.author: FridgeBaron
comments.body: that spritesheet looks terrible? Bmo is just missing an eye in half the frames and they D pad changes shape? It might be getting better but that does not look usable without a lot of fixing.

replies.author: GreatAdvantage57
replies.body: there is a space for a lot of fixes, thx

replies.author: GreatAdvantage57
replies.body: but imagine, if it will create good ones in the future, would you use?

replies.author: FridgeBaron
replies.body: I mean if it actually generated good stuff I imagine I might give it a try. If you are trying to advertise something its weird you didnt bother to make a gif to showcase the animation. The edges of the thing look blurry which would probably make the transparency that I assume the purple is supposed to be look terrible.
